dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped rings with thin, high-contrast outer perimeters and darker interior gradients, most prominent on the lateral-posterior flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of large, asymmetrical low-intensity (black) pixel clusters without internal gradients, concentrated along the dorsal ridge and mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three primary dark blobs on the upper dorsal surface form an elongated obtuse triangle; four distinct 'O' rings on the posterior-lateral surface form a trapezoidal arrangement.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, continuous solid dark patch at the junction of the mid-body and the hind flipper base.
